slide_intent: Use ornamental letterforms selectively because distinctive flourishes should enrich recognition without interrupting reading.

ingredient.name: Ligatures and swashes
ingredient.role: Add distinctive connections and terminals without obstructing words.
ingredient.application: Use available Bold/Regular ligatures; reserve stylistic alternates and discretionary swashes for Bold. Use swashes sparingly and outside longer copy.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guidelines, PDF produced January 2021. This page says only at word beginnings or ends; page 76 describes sentence-position preference as flexible. Preserve the distinction. Printed examples require BK legal trademark clearance and local legal review before use.

reference_purposes.Expression: Enlarged cream lettering makes swash contours visible.
reference_purposes.Application: The text distinguishes ligatures in Bold and Regular from Bold-only stylistic alternates and discretionary swashes.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Swashes should be sparse, avoided in longer copy, and used only at word beginnings or ends on this page.
